trustedLocation: Registered canonical actual host worker root and daemon/Node scope, not caller bundle/extraction directory; private owner/parent/file/single-link/type and immutable registry/journal links verified
markerSemantics: Any nonterminal OR terminal migration journal/registry marker blocks every generic mutator; malformed/unknown/missing-contradictory marker blocks; never clear/delete marker or phase to release legacy tools
notEquivalentTo: 6c worker_config.no_rotation_mutation and rotation_mutation_guard recognize leaf-rotation state only; they are NOT this migration fence
legacyFlagNotAuthority: A bare rotation_publication=True/skip/force flag is never a common-fence lease or migration override; every supported mutating entrypoint and internal publication caller must have a verified operation context
ownership: One shared logical reservation plus held OS lock from scope resolution through every first write/child/side effect/readback/quiescence; a one-shot precheck that exits before the mutator is insufficient

operationMatrix.genericLegacyMutation: DENY in every migration phase including terminal; no repair/start/recopy/workspace/storage/old-v1 resume
operationMatrix.migrationAdvance: ALLOW only exact next event/plan/current IDs under held migration-owner lease and reviewed code/Root execution decision; all other callers DENY
operationMatrix.migrationM2Observe: ALLOW read-only Node-state observer only under typed predecessor contract and held migration-owner lease/start intent; controlled Docker exec metadata tracked separately
operationMatrix.normal3ObserveAndMutate: ALLOW only after typed terminal seal/current inventory and separately owned new common-fence normal:3 lease/immutable plan; cannot use legacy generic wrapper or migration baseline P/H

mandatoryEntrypoints: Controller cohort prepare/stage/commit/retire/metadata publication adapters and NEW renewal guard/launchers
legacySchedulerSurfaces: DENIED generic registration/re-registration/invocation/execution for all migration marker phases, including terminal; a newly registered Windows task outside the three disabled Orca IDs is still an unauthorized launch surface and G9 HOLD
secondMigration: DENY any second binary migration or new migration ID/target on a Node with an existing migration journal/seal until a separate reviewed design; no predecessor deletion/replacement/rotation, no marker reset; ordinary approved normal:3 leaf renewal is not a second binary migration
firstMutationBoundary: Guard before mkdir/CSR/key generation/copy/archive publication/image load/container start/stop/create/rename/restart or CP channel/publication mutation; read-only manifest parsing may only resolve and verify trusted existing scope
directFunctionAndRawInvocationLimits: Future supported Python mutator functions require guard-owned operation context themselves, not just a top-level wrapper; Shell/PowerShell entrypoints delegate to fixed hash-bound guard runner that holds ownership for the entire operation

All supported launchers and direct helper entrypoints must be replaced by actual reviewed guard-compatible source/artifacts and tested; listing a basename or placing a marker does not retrofit old unmodified source03/B5 scripts

Old archived/unpatched raw scripts, arbitrary imports/monkeypatches and raw privileged Docker/shell invocation are OUTSIDE the authorized managed interface and forbidden by Root operation policy; marker files cannot stop a privileged actor bypassing the guard

If any such raw/unpatched mutator remains an allowed/reachable operation or an in-flight child/precheck is unknown, G9 stays HOLD; no claim of OS/permission enforcement and no permission changes are made by this plan
requiredFutureTests: Every listed entrypoint, including direct functions and terminal marker states, refuses before first side effect; wrong directory/owner/token/removal/leaf-marker-only/raw legacy launcher cannot bypass; legitimate guarded normal:3 later renewal still reaches typed retained predecessor
